retrievalProfile.description: A tight, dramatic facial portrait featuring a high-contrast subject with realistic molten lava cracks and glowing embers integrated into the skin texture against a dark, stormy atmosphere.
triggerTerms: dramatic low-key portrait with stormy background

recipe.visualDefinition: A hyper-realistic close-up portrait of a man where one side of his face and forehead is consumed by deep, jagged fissures revealing glowing orange magma and charred, rocky skin textures, set against a turbulent, desaturated blue-grey sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between smooth human skin and jagged, glowing volcanic textures
Tight framing focusing on the intensity of the eyes and facial expression
Cool-toned background vs. warm-toned internal glow of the scars
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and power
coreInvariants: Internal orange glow emanating from within the facial cracks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered face filling approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing molten scar on the upper right side of the face (viewer's right).
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the intense gaze of the eyes upward to the glowing forehead cracks, then down the side of the face following the lava flow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, restricted to the upper corners showing a dark, cloudy sky.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns (clothing and skin shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and fiery red (molten lava and embers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark skin/background and the luminous, highly saturated orange glow.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family block typography for utilitarian labeling.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for a warning label style.
Clean, authoritative, and fits within a tight rectangular footprint.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail portrait of a man with a serious expression, featuring realistic cracked skin on the forehead and cheek that glows with internal orange magma. The background should be a dark, stormy sky with swirling blue-grey clouds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, white, condensed sans-serif text block inside a black rectangular frame in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the lava glow luminous against the skin?
Is the framing a tight close-up on the face?
Is the background stormy and desaturated?
Is the text block positioned in the bottom right corner?

mustAchieve: Realistic integration of lava texture into skin pores
Cinematic lighting with clear rim light
avoid: Flat, cartoonish orange paint instead of glowing magma

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic subsurface scattering in the glowing areas
Ensure the eyes maintain a sharp, intense focus
Verify the text box does not obscure facial features
Confirm the color temperature contrast between blue and orange is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Portrait] + [Volcanic/Molten Texture Overlay] + [Stormy Atmosphere] + [High-Contrast Low-Key Lighting].
